Saturday’s Mercury opposes Uranus in the 3rd, delivering income ideas. Sunday’s Leo Moon squares Jupiter in the 7th, energizing expression, cautioning partnership agreements, delivering a finish. Best day: Venus moves into the 5th House, igniting a romance. Worst day: Monday, Mercury’s square to Venus in the 7th House sparks breakdowns souring love and money. Use 5th House Venus for a date that builds affection and prudence. Follow for daily updates.
